home.title: Khabro — Local news for your city, clearly told
home.description: Khabro is a calm local-news reader for Indian cities: city-specific updates, clear publisher sourcing, and no account required.

about.title: About Khabro — Local news reader for Indian cities
about.description: Khabro is building a calm front door to city news for readers who want the important update quickly, clearly, and without account friction.

contact.title: Contact Khabro — App support and developer contact
contact.description: Contact Khabro at contact@khabro.in for app support, publisher requests, corrections, privacy questions, or policy matters.

privacy.title: Privacy policy — Khabro
privacy.description: How Khabro handles device preferences, optional location matching, and technical request data when you use the website or mobile reader.

terms.title: Terms of use — Khabro
terms.description: Terms for using Khabro’s local news discovery, summaries, bookmarks, and links to original publisher reports.

support.title: Support — Khabro
support.description: Get help with the Khabro reader or website. Include your city, device, and steps to reproduce so we can investigate quickly.

corrections.title: Corrections and takedown — Khabro
corrections.description: Report inaccurate summaries, attribution issues, publisher rights concerns, privacy requests, or urgent safety issues to Khabro.
